method: Targeted primary-source synthesis,not systematic review;rendered/indexed access distinguished from retained raw-byte verification. No new empirical likelihood or prior adopted.

sources.estimand: Compliance and nearby points of sale, three Dutch cities,2021/2025
sources.limitation: Pre/post retail availability is not tobacco consumption, illicit switching or a NZ600-outlet causal effect. Specialist substitution and access measures differ from outlet counts.

sources.estimand: US cigarette purchasing after pharmacy removal;13 intervention/3 control states
sources.limitation: Purchasing cessation is not smoking cessation or illicit origin. Authors affiliated with CVS; observational comparison/market exposure and NZ transport require review.

sources.locator: Author-hosted primary PDF Methods and Table3;percentage-point probability margins; DOI10.1016/j.amepre.2019.09.003
sources.limitation: Quit attempts are not net cessation; daily/nondaily smoking did not change detectably. Shares the CVS intervention with purchase study; do not pool as independent policy replications.

sources.estimand: National retailer licensing and youth smoking/access;multiple surveys
sources.limitation: Single-country pre/post design and concurrent controls limit causal attribution; youth prevalence and proxy purchasing do not identify adult NZ switching. Survey waves are not independent policy experiments.

sources.estimand: Analytical nicotine/tobacco biomarkers across NZ wastewater plants
sources.limitation: Reported method concentration is retained without a raw-sewage conversion. Few samples exceeded ANBA quantification. Yield, sample processing, mixed-product sources and temporal coverage must be qualified before volume inference.

sources.estimand: 24-hour urinary excretion as percent estimated absorbed anabasine,selected cigarette users

reported_numbers.plus_minus_type: not independently established; not used as CI/SE

sources.limitation: Preliminary selected sample; relies on COT+3HC excretion72.12% and smoking-machine absorption. Observed range is not target coverage. Vaping contribution/excretion is not zero or identified; not a direct wastewater conversion.

sources.locator: Retained nine-asset reconciliation and workbook receipt
sources.estimand: Calendar2025 reported retail releases in native sticks and tonnes
sources.limitation: BAT year and R&S unit conflicts; missing channels/stock/visitor adjustments remain. Original objects are previously verified, not freshly recovered; manufacturer/summary aliases share underlying returns. Fresh rendered BAT2025-linked PDF still states2024;raw bytes were not newly archived.
Prevalence is not total/lawful volume or calendar2025 matched data. Need intensity/product/population mapping and underlying repeated observations; reused NZHS summaries are not new data.

sources.estimand: Detected importing/sales offences and court dispositions
sources.limitation: Observed offences establish occurrence, not population incidence, prevented consumption or incremental harm under the cap. No causal harm coefficient or sampling denominator supplied.

sources.estimand: Australian inquiry testimony about illicit-market harms
sources.limitation: Full-page fetch denied; limited discovery only. Reported incidents/testimony are not a NZ marginal-harm estimate or a causal effect of600-retailer restriction.

sources.estimand: Agency appropriations rather than cap-specific resource use
sources.limitation: No target incremental cost extracted. Whole-agency expenditure or lost excise cannot substitute for the proposed policy/study resource costs.

sources.locator: Finalised3November2021;printedp30 marginal costs table;pp32-33 cost/recovery and enforcement
sources.estimand: Prospective bundled-package regulator costs over four years
sources.limitation: Modelled package-wide cost benchmark,not a confidence range,600-cap incremental cost or study cost. Total monetised costs not calculated;future implementation scope/cost work explicitly required. No conversion to normalised M2 units.

sources.estimand: Historical consumption-gap arithmetic in reported cigarette-equivalent units
sources.limitation: Reuses MOH/NZHS inputs and fixed uplift,not an independent observed illicit count or causal effect. Survey/calendar/product/0.7g conventions and stock/border error remain;no current-target transport.

residual_requirements.requirement: Select legally feasible policy/implementation,actual timing,catchments and credible comparison;the600-cap has no observed NZ implementation.
Obtain matched raw assay/flow/population and lawful supply/stock/visitor/border/intensity records;seek existing administrative/laboratory records before commissioning new collection.
Resolve BAT year,R&S pack/carton and unreported-channel ambiguities if point totals are decision-relevant;alternatives can remain for robust analysis.
Target-applicable near-limit recovery,censoring,yield/product absorption and vaping contribution;new laboratory/field validation only where existing validation records cannot support transport.

Matched policy-response,mitigation/replacement and incremental-harm outcomes with a defensible counterfactual,including held-out target predictions;existing linked records may suffice if available. Transparent expert elicitation can support a conditional analysis but requires human responses and does not supply empirical validation.
Actual policy/study resource quantities,unit costs and adoption/timing;existing cost records or supplier estimates before new observational research.
Maori governance/permissible use,equitable coverage,privacy/access decisions and normative health/crime/cost trade-offs.
